name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Esper Sentinel's triggered ability

prerequisites.timing: whenever Esper Sentinel's triggered ability would trigger
other: Esper Sentinel's oracle text: Whenever an opponent casts their first noncreature spell each turn, draw a card unless that player pays {X}, where X is this creature's power.

Requires Esper Sentinel to have power 2 or less at the time of the trigger (Delney's ability text: "Creatures you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater. If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.") - both cards confirm this at their printed base power, but power can change from effects elsewhere in the deck (e.g. -1/-1 counters, boosts); not checked against every other card's interaction with this power threshold.

Meaningfully raises the effective tax rate of a card already valued primarily for its tax; relevant to Phase 21 engine realization (Esper Sentinel is one of the assignment's named engines to measure).

result.summary: Esper Sentinel's tax trigger fires twice on an opponent's first noncreature spell each turn: they must pay X (Esper Sentinel's power) separately for each instance to deny each draw, or you draw up to 2 cards instead of 1.

sources.reference: Independent pairwise scan of card_cache oracle text against Delney's triggered-ability-doubling clause, 2026-08-12 (not indexed as a formal combo by Commander Spellbook - this is a value multiplier, not a win line).
